instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show me every tour in my workspace and which ones I have finished", and give it the records it works over: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-workspace-tours and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the tours your AIs wrote (guided-overlay::own-walkthroughs) and your tour progress, with the app's own tours when the caller passes them as tours, and answers each tour in its order: tour_id, title, summary, steps, finished, the event that starts it by name (start_event), when the change it shows landed (changed_at) and whether it is one of your own.
4. It has no records door and keeps nothing: it works over the records you hand in (own_tours, progress, show_rules), read from the store that holds them.
